question: What is worshipable by kula-conduct, and what especially on festival days?
premises: by kula-conduct, O mistress of gods, worshipable for success-liberation
who on festival days, O mistress
inference: Kula-conduct worship for siddhi-mukti; festival-day tarpana especially.
plain_english: By kula-conduct, O mistress of gods, worshipable for success-liberation — who on festival days, O mistress, satisfaction especially.
